jobs.title: Lead – Cybersecurity Compliance
jobs.description:
Lead – Cybersecurity Compliance

About the Role

TAC Infosec Ltd. is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Lead – Compliance to oversee compliance initiatives, manage information security frameworks, coordinate internal and external audits, and ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in information security compliance, risk management, governance frameworks, audit management, and cybersecurity regulations. The role requires close collaboration with internal teams, clients, auditors, and external stakeholders to maintain a strong compliance posture across business operations and cybersecurity services.

Key Responsibilities

1. Compliance Management
• Develop, implement, and maintain compliance policies, procedures, standards, and internal controls.
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and industry-specific standards.
• Monitor changes in cybersecurity regulations and compliance requirements and assess their impact on the organization.
• Maintain compliance registers, evidence repositories, risk logs, and documentation for audits and assessments.
• Establish compliance monitoring processes and report compliance gaps to senior management.

2. Information Security Frameworks
• Lead the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of relevant information security and compliance frameworks, including:
• ISO/IEC 27001 – Information Security Management System (ISMS).
• SOC 2 – Trust Services Criteria.
• NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
• CIS Critical Security Controls.
• GDPR and applicable data protection requirements.
• CERT-In directions and other applicable Indian cybersecurity regulations.
• Support readiness assessments, gap analyses, risk assessments, and remediation planning.
• Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure policies and controls are implemented effectively.

3. Audit Management
• Plan and coordinate internal audits, external audits, certification assessments, and client compliance reviews.
• Prepare audit documentation, evidence, control matrices, and compliance reports.
• Coordinate with auditors and relevant stakeholders to address audit observations and findings.
• Track corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely closure of identified gaps.
• Maintain audit trails and ensure documentation is accurate, complete, and readily available.

4. Risk Management and Governance
• Conduct compliance risk assessments and identify gaps in existing processes and controls.
• Develop risk mitigation plans and monitor their implementation.
• Maintain risk registers, control assessments, and management reporting.
• Support business continuity, incident response, vendor risk management, and information security governance activities.
• Escalate significant compliance risks and control deficiencies to senior management.

5. Data Protection and Regulatory Compliance
• Support compliance with applicable data privacy and protection laws, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, as applicable, and GDPR where relevant.
• Assist in reviewing data processing agreements, confidentiality requirements, privacy policies, and contractual security obligations.
• Coordinate with relevant teams on data handling, retention, access control, and incident reporting requirements.
• Support privacy impact assessments and third-party compliance reviews where required.

6. Client and Business Support
• Support client security assessments, vendor due diligence, RFPs, security questionnaires, and compliance-related queries.
• Work closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, Engineering, HR, IT, and Legal teams to address compliance requirements.
• Provide compliance inputs for client contracts, security commitments, and business proposals.
• Communicate compliance requirements to internal stakeholders and support client audits and assessments.

7. Team Leadership and Continuous Improvement
• Lead and mentor compliance team members and coordinate cross-functional compliance activities.
• Conduct compliance awareness sessions and training for employees.
• Establish key compliance metrics and provide periodic reports to management.
• Identify opportunities to automate compliance monitoring, evidence collection, and reporting.
• Promote a culture of accountability, security awareness, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Law, Risk Management, or a related field.
• Relevant professional certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CISM are preferred.
• Strong knowledge of information security governance, risk management, compliance frameworks, and audit methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills
• 6–10 years of experience in information security compliance, GRC, IT audits, cybersecurity governance, or risk management.
• Proven experience implementing or maintaining ISO 27001, SOC 2, or comparable compliance frameworks.
• Experience managing internal and external audits, regulatory assessments, and client compliance reviews.
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity controls, policies, risk assessments, and remediation processes.
• Familiarity with data privacy regulations and third-party risk management.
• Excellent documentation, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple compliance initiatives and work effectively across departments.
• Experience with GRC or compliance automation tools is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Timely completion of internal and external audits.
• Percentage of compliance gaps and audit findings closed within agreed timelines.
• Maintenance of applicable certifications and compliance requirements.
• Effectiveness of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.
• Accuracy and completeness of compliance documentation and audit evidence.
• Timely completion of client security assessments and compliance questionnaires.
• Employee compliance awareness and training completion rates.
• Improvement in compliance monitoring and reporting efficiency.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a proactive compliance professional with strong knowledge of cybersecurity governance, risk management, and regulatory frameworks. The candidate should be capable of independently managing compliance programs, leading audit activities, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that TAC Infosec Ltd. maintains a robust and continuously improving compliance posture.

jobs.title: Specialist, Cybersecurity - Insider Threat Response Analyst
jobs.description:
Specialist, Cybersecurity – Insider Threat Response Analyst

Position Summary

The Specialist, Cybersecurity supports Nationwide’s Insider Threat Program by monitoring and triaging alerts related to potentially suspicious employee, contractor, and user activity. The role helps identify possible policy violations, unauthorized activity, and data loss or exfiltration risks by reviewing alerts, analyzing logs and contextual information, gathering evidence, documenting cases, and escalating validated concerns to the appropriate investigation team. The team’s primary monitoring tool is Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management, with additional detections in a Palo Alto SIEM environment.

Role Focus Areas

The hiring team considers two related profiles. Candidates may align more strongly with one focus area:

1. Insider Risk Monitoring and Alert Triage
• Monitor and review Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management alerts.
• Triage alerts and validate whether user activity appears suspicious or requires further review.
• Gather relevant context and supporting evidence, apply sound judgment, and distinguish potentially risky activity from legitimate or personal activity where appropriate.
• Create and document investigation cases, then escalate validated cases to the deeper investigation team.
• Review activity involving potential data exfiltration, suspicious external sharing, unusual use of tools, policy violations, and other insider-risk indicators.

2. Insider Threat Detection and SIEM Analysis
• Review and analyze alerts and detections in the Palo Alto SIEM environment.
• Search and correlate logs to assess suspicious activity and investigate security events.
• Review existing detection logic and recommend tuning to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.
• Support the maintenance and improvement of queries, dashboards, automation, and investigation workflows.
• Use query-based analysis to identify patterns, validate detections, and provide recommendations for improvement.

Key Responsibilities
• Monitor insider-risk and security alerts generated by Microsoft Purview and other relevant security tools.
• Analyze user activity, authentication events, endpoint activity, and security logs to validate suspicious behavior.
• Recognize potential data theft or exfiltration, unauthorized access, misuse of privileges, policy violations, and suspicious use of applications or tools.
• Correlate information across systems and use contextual judgment to determine whether an alert should be documented, closed, or escalated.
• Gather supporting evidence and maintain clear, accurate case documentation.
• Escalate validated cases to the appropriate team for deeper investigation; this role does not necessarily own end-to-end investigations.
• For SIEM-focused work, review detections, develop or refine queries, and recommend tuning or dashboard improvements.
• Support automation and continuous improvement of monitoring and investigation workflows where appropriate.
• Work collaboratively with cybersecurity, threat intelligence, and relevant partner teams.

Qualification Criteria

Required Skills and Experience
• BE / BTech with 5-8 years of experience with strong Foundational cybersecurity experience in a SOC, security monitoring, cybersecurity analysis, incident response, threat hunting, or a related role.
• Experience reviewing security alerts and investigating or validating suspicious activity; candidates should demonstrate an investigative mindset rather than only passive alert monitoring.
• Hands-on exposure to SIEM tools and the ability to review alerts, search logs, and correlate security events. Relevant platforms may include Palo Alto, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, Cortex, or comparable tools.
• Log analysis experience, including security, authentication, endpoint, or user activity logs.
• Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems; macOS exposure is beneficial.
• Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, and common security-related communications.
• Ability to use judgment, document findings clearly, and follow appropriate escalation processes.

Preferred Skills
• Direct experience with Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management or an Insider Threat Program.
• SQL or other query-writing experience for security event and log analysis.
• XQL experience, particularly for Palo Alto SIEM detection analysis.
• PowerShell or Python scripting for investigation support, log parsing, or automation. Scripting is beneficial but is not a strict screening knockout.
• Detection tuning, dashboard improvement, security analytics, or threat hunting experience.
• Digital forensics, evidence collection and preservation, cloud security, behavioral analytics, and familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

Additional Information

Role Context and Candidate Calibration
• The triage-focused profile is centered on daily alert review, validation, evidence gathering, and case creation.
• The SIEM-focused profile requires stronger query and detection-analysis capability, including reviewing and tuning detections.
• The role is part of a broader team; deeper investigations are handed over to the relevant investigation group.

Microsoft Purview is the primary tool for current insider-risk monitoring, and Palo Alto is used for SIEM detections.

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Operating as a front ‑ end sales specialist, you will own pipeline creation and deal closure while working in close alignment with Enterprise and Mid ‑ Market Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and Channel Partners.
